title: HELIX Bridge: Workday HCM → Worker / Employee
architecture_notes: Workday uses 'Worker' as the universal entity — an Employee is a worker type (the other is Contingent Worker). Every worker has one or more Job records (primary + additional). Unlike PeopleSoft (where EMPLID is a flat number), Workday Worker IDs can be system-generated or institution-defined. Worker data is effective-dated via Workday's native event framework: every change (hire, transfer, promotion, termination) is a discrete business process event with an effective date. Workday's security is role-based and tied to supervisory organizations.

source_objects.description: Core identity: worker ID, name, contact info, SSN/national ID, date of birth, citizenship, visa. Equivalent to PS_PERSONAL_DATA + PS_PERSON + PS_PERS_NID.
Current and historical job assignments: position, supervisory org, job profile, location, FTE, pay rate group, worker type (employee/contingent). Equivalent to PS_JOB.
Hire date, original hire date, continuous service date, termination date, termination reason, rehire status. Equivalent to PS_EMPLOYMENT + PS_JOB.EMPL_STATUS.
Home address, work address, phone numbers, email addresses (work, personal). Equivalent to PS_ADDRESSES + PS_PERSONAL_PHONE + PS_EMAIL_ADDRESSES.
Attached documents: I-9, W-4, certifications, licenses.

notes: Worker data is highly sensitive. SSN/national ID must be tokenized at the silver layer. PII handling per institutional policy. IPEDS reporting requires ethnicity, gender, FTE, and employee type for the annual HR survey.
